name: skill-design-standards
description: Design and review portable Agent Skills with focused workflows, reproducible script interfaces, and evidence-based evaluations.

interface.shortDescription: Design, audit, and evaluate reusable agent skills.
interface.longDescription: A self-contained design standard for skill authors and operators. Separates Agent Skills format requirements from design recommendations and host configuration, guides script interfaces and description optimization, and defines evidence-based output-quality evaluations.
defaultPrompt: Use $skill-design-standards to audit this skill and distinguish format errors from design recommendations.
Use $skill-design-standards to improve this skill while preserving its scope and authorization boundaries.
Use $skill-design-standards to design an evaluation comparing these skill versions.
